integrity: The proof counts adjoint ranks directly from the semidirect-product bracket and derives the commutativity degree from the exact rank strata. A standalone verifier reconstructs the Lie bracket and adjoint maps over four finite fields, including the nonprime field of order four.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite-dimensional almost-abelian Lie algebras over finite fields.
The commutativity degree recovers the derived-subalgebra dimension but not the similarity class of the defining endomorphism.
The exact rank distribution is an element-level invariant and does not address subalgebra commutativity.
title: Almost-abelian Lie algebras have rank-only commutativity spectra
